leads.title: Constitution of Fiji (2013), Article 26(3)
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on unfair discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression
leads.detail: Promulgated September 2013; Article 26(3)(a) quoted verbatim in article; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Crimes Decree 2009
leads.documents: Decriminalization of private, adult, consensual non-commercial male and female homosexual conduct
leads.detail: Cited as effective 1 February 2010; no URL visible in text

leads.title: 2005 sodomy case ruling - McCosker and Nadan overturned August 2005
leads.documents: Nation's highest court overturning sodomy conviction of Thomas McCosker and Dhirendra Nadan as violating Constitution; enforcement precedent
leads.detail: Dated 2005, overturned August 2005; Australian tourist and adult partner tried and jailed then acquitted; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Employment Relations Promulgation 2007
leads.documents: Ban on discrimination in employment based on sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited in Discrimination protections section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Mental Health Decree 2010
leads.documents: Provides persons not to be considered mentally ill if they refuse/fail to express particular sexual orientation; prohibits conversion therapy by registered mental health professionals
leads.detail: Cited in Conversion therapy section; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Fiji family law / Marriage Act - same-sex marriage ban since 2002
leads.documents: No legal recognition of same-sex marriage or civil unions; express ban since 2002; union limited to male and female
leads.detail: Cited with PM statements 26 March 2013, Jan 2016, 2019 and 2022 debate; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Fiji Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination Commission - Director Ashwin Raj
leads.documents: Rights machinery position: same-sex marriage is not a right, priority is violence/discrimination; investigation of blood donation ban as unconstitutional
leads.detail: Statements cited for 2017 blood policy and 2019 and 2022 marriage debate; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Fijian Ministry of Health - April 2017 blood donation statement
leads.documents: Government policy banning gay and bisexual men from donating blood after gay man refused
leads.detail: Dated April 2017; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Fiji Coalition on Human Rights - 2019 statement
leads.documents: Institutional rebuke that PM's 'no same-sex marriage' stance contradicts Fiji laws and UN Human Rights Council commitment; calls for inclusion discussion
leads.detail: Dated 2019 response to Prime Minister Frank Bainimarama; no URL visible in text

leads.title: An Island Calling (2008 New Zealand documentary)
leads.documents: Documented incident: 1 July 2001 brutal murder in Suva of Red Cross leader John Maurice Scott and partner Gregory Scrivener in apparent homophobic attack
leads.detail: 2008 documentary cited in Social conditions section; no URL visible in text
